name: Read the native Government tier and official change gate after the completed Plaza

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'original captive changed'); local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; assert(g and p.cities[1].district and p.cities[1].cityID==65536,'completed Government Plaza or Government reader missing'); local t=g.target; local w=b.Tier1GovernmentWindowCivic(); return 'windowCivic='..tostring(w and w.civicType)..' plan='..p.stage..' current='..tostring(g.currentType)..' tier='..tostring(g.currentTier)..' target='..tostring(t and t.governmentType)..' civic='..tostring(t and t.civicType)..' missingPrereqs='..table.concat(t and t.missingPrerequisites or {},',')..' civicOwned='..tostring(t and t.civicOwned)..' unlocked='..tostring(t and t.unlocked)..' gate='..tostring(g.stage)..' missing='..tostring(g.missing)..' canChange='..tostring(g.canChangeAtAll)..' changeMade='..tostring(g.changeMade)..' civicThisTurn='..tostring(g.civicCompletedThisTurn)..' strategic='..tostring(g.strategicCommands)..' openSlots='..tostring(g.openPolicySlots)..' unlockCost='..tostring(g.policyUnlockCost)..' production='..tostring(p.cities[1].tier1Production.BUILDING_GOV_TALL and p.cities[1].tier1Production.BUILDING_GOV_TALL.reasons)
ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('PROBE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API'); return 'read-only Gameplay Government API probe queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PROBE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API' or a=='UNKNOWN_PROBE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API' or a=='REJECTED_PROBE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PROBE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API'

steps.code: local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_API_PROBE')); assert(r.owner==0 and r.turn==Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() and (r.status=='OBSERVED' or r.status=='API_UNAVAILABLE' or r.status=='READ_FAILED'),'Gameplay Government API diagnostic changed'); return 'gameplayStatus='..r.status..' getter='..r.getter..' index='..tostring(r.index)..' uiBridge='..r.uiBridge..' civicModifiers='..r.civicModifiers..' modifierArguments='..r.modifierArguments..' dynamicModifiers='..r.dynamicModifiers..' civicPrereqs='..r.civicPrereqs
